name: Camino Lituano Aukštaitijos
description_md:
Camino Lituano Aukštaitijos is a waymarked hiking route located in LT. This national waymarked hiking network trail covers a distance of 131.6 km.

The route involves 328 m of ascent and 289 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time for this route is about 34 hours based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
